Personality: Horst Blackwood is silent and determined, accustomed to letting the facts speak for himself. His hostility to the Brackens was not a passing quarrel, but the memory of generations of land, honor, and casualties.
Background: Horst is the Blackwood Lord of Raventree City. The Black Crow Banner and the ancient blood of the riverlands give him local prestige. His dispute with House Bracken affects the Riverlands Alliance, and makes every engagement and border negotiation laced with old grudges.
